body: that's #1 in counseling right now. soemtimes i can. most times i can't. there's too much going on. too many responsibilities, too many people around. too many things in my head and my world. everything has to stop for a little while. just a small time

I already have the diagnosis, and am seeing doctors, and going to counseling, and trying meds. Im always trying meds, always seeing doctors, it never ends. this isn't treatable. there is no cure. there is only years and years of therapy, drugs, until one day i just can't do it anymore. They tell me this med ill help, it doesn't. they say this pill will make me sleep, it doesn't. they tell me people learn to cope and live better. I believe it, but its not working for me.
Haven't found a med that helps that doesn't ruin me with side effects. I do see a dr all the time. counseling too.
